summary.text: Ellyn Hefner is a Democratic member of the Oklahoma House of Representatives who has represented District 87 since 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Ellyn Hefner's career experience, according to Ballotpedia, includes owning a business, working as a health coordinator with the Oklahoma Family Network and working as a financial advisor with Bluecrest Financial Alliances.
Ballotpedia says she served as board chair of the Daily Living Centers in Oklahoma City and as president of the Sotos Syndrome Support Association.

She took office on November 23, 2022, succeeding Collin Walke, and Ballotpedia lists her 2025-2026 committee assignments as the Select Committee to Review Mental Health Finances, the Health and Human Services Oversight Committee and the House Rules Committee.
Codey Bartle, a Republican, is her opponent in the November 3, 2026 general election.
